content.short: Nansen Portfolio tracks all your DeFi holdings in a single dashboard.
content.description: Create unlimited DeFi portfolios by bundling wallets across more than 40 chains and over 500 protocols, giving you a single, comprehensive view of your on-chain activity. Connect your wallet to see an in-depth portrait of your DeFi holdings, supported by robust on-chain analytics. Access insights drawn from a dataset of roughly 240 million labeled wallets and broad analytical tools to understand exposure, diversification, and trends across your entire portfolio.
content.meta: Nansen Portfolio helps you track all your DeFi holdings in a single dashboard. Discover Nansen Portfolio and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
